name: Visitation
source:
Only you know tragedy will strike

It was supposed to be nothing but a pit stop. A short visit to a quiet town on their way to L.A. quickly turned into disaster for Paige and Grigol. A situation that threatens to destroy the fragile relationship between the two, that just begun to heal.
Confronted with the loose ends of their past, the two of them set out to stop the approaching catastrophe, unaware of just how grave the stakes truly are.
"Visitation" is a dramatic Visual Novel Thriller about social connections, personal growth and believe. Gather intel, form alliances or burn bridges. Whatever you do, it's your decision.

[From [url=https://yaminotama.itch.io/visitation]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
只有你知道悲剧即将发生

这本来应该只是一个进站。佩奇和格里戈尔在前往洛杉矶的途中短暂参观了一个安静的小镇，但很快就变成了一场灾难。这种情况有可能破坏两人之间刚刚开始愈合的脆弱关系。
面对过去的未解之谜，两人出发阻止即将到来的灾难，却没有意识到其中的利害关系到底有多么严重。
《拜访》是一部关于社会关系、个人成长和信仰的戏剧性视觉小说惊悚片。收集情报、结成联盟或断桥。无论你做什么，都是你的决定。

[来自[url=https://yaminotama.itch.io/visitation]Itch.io[/url]]
